aiResearchSummary.text: Tagore Technology is developing gallium nitride power devices and control circuits for radio frequency applications. Work such as Gate bias circuit for a driver monolithically integrated with a GaN power FET and Under voltage lock-out circuit focuses on monolithic GaN integration and supply protection, while Temperature-adaptive gate driver for GaN switch addresses gate to source voltage tuning with temperature, highlighting research in GaN power stages, drivers and protection circuitry.
